_note: Ceiling and wall light fixtures. Each one hangs on a light outlet from the developer's installation plan (data/floorplan.json fixtures_reference.light_outlets) unless it says otherwise. Metres in the Blender frame. Watts are Cycles light power, tuned by eye for the evening renders, not lamp ratings.

fixtures.note: Recessed linear LED profile in the ceiling: from just inside the entrance door it runs north through outlet A, turns 90 degrees at outlet B's Y and runs west through B into the kitchen. Path = (A.x, start_y) -> (A.x, B.y) -> (end_x, B.y), so both outlets feed it.
Opal globes over the counter and the oak table (0.80 m above it). NOT on an outlet: they need a cable run in the ceiling from outlet B, 0.76 m south of them.

_wall_lights: The bathroom mirror light sits on wall outlet E1 (h 2.30 m); it is part of the bath_counter item in data/furniture.json (params light_at / light_z).
